notes.title: Update 3.0.7
notes.content:
Changelog

Fixes
Fixed an issue where the rival’s vehicle might not be displayed in the results when the rival finished first in Single Rally

Fixed an issue where some trees disappeared in Nordic Lakeside

Fixed light intensity

Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update 3.0.6
notes.content:
Changelog
Fixes
Fixed an issue and error that occurred when retrieving internal IDs during online ranking uploads

Fixed an issue where uploading online rankings could potentially overwrite other players’ times  

This will take effect on the next initial time registration.

Fixed an issue where iOS could sometimes fail to connect online at startup

Fixed an issue where entering certain characters in the serial code would cause a crash

Fixed an issue where race clear status was not reflected correctly

Removed the retry count setting for Single Rally  

Minor fix to grip handling during vehicle side slip  

The minimum grip level has been slightly raised. Further fixes/adjustments will be made in v3.1.

Fixed an issue where Class A vehicles had weak braking performance  

All vehicles will be adjusted in v3.1.

Fixed an issue where terrain appeared to reflect unnaturally

Fixed an issue where terrain protruded into distant roads

Fixed an issue where lights did not reach long distances  

The issue where lights do not illuminate the road is still under investigation.

Fixed an issue where performance became slower the longer you played

Temporary fix for keyboard input not working on ChromeOS

Major fixes to memory management

Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update 3.0.5
notes.content:
Changelog
Fixes
Fixed an issue where errors could occur during UI navigation with a controller.

Fixed an issue where these errors could result in excessive log traffic.

Fixed button settings for left/right steering and gear up/down

  Due to internal updates, the corresponding button assignments will be reset.

Fixed rendering issues with decorative (prop) trucks on the Kaido map.

Applied a provisional fix for an issue where multiple ads could play simultaneously in the background.

Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update 3.0.4
notes.content:
Changelog
Fixes
Fixed a numeric parsing error that occurred in certain locales using comma decimal notation.

Fixed an issue where the game could gradually become sluggish after long play sessions or repeated scene transitions.

Fixed an issue where the controller would vibrate even when not using controller input while connected.

Other minor fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Update 3.0.2
notes.content:
Update v3.0.2

 
Changelog
 
Changes
Restored grip during drifting to approximately 80% of the previous level

Increased the threshold for grip break

  Grip loss is now less likely to occur than before.

Restored downforce values for nearly all vehicles to their previous levels

  Grip during drifting has also been brought back to nearly the same as before.



Fixes
Fixed an issue where an error could occur in Single Rally when finishing in 4th place or lower

Fixed display issues on the difficulty selection screen for 6.5-inch smartphones

Fixed an issue in Windmills Hill where the vehicle could get stuck when respawning in the river during Free Run

Other minor fixes

Fixed an issue where steering assist was forcibly disabled during touch controls

Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update v3.0
notes.content:
Update v3.0.0


Changelog

Additions
Added new game mode: Single Rally  

  A mode optimized for the most efficient credit earning.

Added new D1 class vehicle: EM1

Added new C1 class vehicle: LCP

Rebuilt the Windmill Hill course and its stages  

  Includes 6 stages.

Rankings reset due to incompatibility with rebuilt courses/stages  

  Previous rankings will be archived.  

  Going forward, rankings will reset only for courses that are rebuilt.



Changes
Added vibration feedback for controllers  

  Currently supported only on the Steam version.

Removed Nordic Woodland and merged it into Nordic Lakeside due to asset limitations

Adjusted overall rewards in conjunction with the implementation of Single Rally

BGM playback now separated for home and race screens

Increased stick rotation speed for the home screen camera

Changed course/stage/weather selection to proceed with a single input when using keyboard or controller

Replaced rain weather with snow for Nordic SnowFields and Winter Cliff

Fixed the number of race opponents to 2

Players will now return to the course after deviating a certain distance off the road

Discontinued the K class and merged it into the E class

Moved FSZ to the X class

Adjusted vehicle handling to allow for sliding under strong lateral G-forces

Increased headlight brightness for all vehicles

Improved the simulation accuracy for suspension impact on landing

Increased clutch sensitivity for all vehicles

Adjusted gear change and clutch engagement times for all vehicles

Tweaked aerodynamic properties across all vehicles

Adjusted exhaust sounds globally

Performed global performance balancing

Temporarily disabled collision sounds due to internal collision handling issues

Added support for analog input (e.g., stick-type) in steering settings  

  This reset all button assignments to default values.

Removed "Default View" option from gameplay settings

Changed pace note call timing to a selectable setting

Renamed "Resolution" setting to "Resolution Scale"

Changed keybind settings display from two columns to one

Removed keyboard input support on smartphones  

  Due to multiple issues with simultaneous inputs and hardware limitations, support has been discontinued to reduce maintenance costs.

Added analog controller input support to Photo Mode  

  Allows for more precise control.

When using Photo Mode on smartphones, screenshots are now saved directly to the device without showing a share screen

Changed filenames of Photo Mode screenshots to date format

Removed save data migration support from v1  

  Updating from v1 to v3 using old save data may result in corruption, and we do not guarantee proper operation.  

  Corrupted save data will not be supported.

In the Steam version, player names now default to the Steam username

Offensive terms in user or vehicle names will now be censored

Adjusted post-processing effects

Optimized communication with the server for rankings and ghost data

Other minor adjustments


Fixes
Fixed issue where gamepad inputs were treated as digital

Fixed "Back" button remaining visible even at the top of the home screen

Fixed reversed mouse wheel scroll direction on the course/stage/weather selection screen

Fixed forced scroll-back to previously tapped course in course/stage/weather selection

Fixed UI color for Vinyl 5 on WRB

Fixed internal errors caused by button mashing on certain screens

Fixed an issue where pausing could be triggered while adjusting settings

Fixed rapid item selection when using stick input

Fixed cars rolling on slopes before the race starts

Fixed rain continuing after switching back to the home screen from a race

Improved hit detection for vehicles on water surfaces and similar

Fixed submersion sound not respecting SE volume settings

Fixed issue where the camera could no longer be changed partway through Kaido Stage 1

Fixed falling through terrain gaps in Winter Cliff

Fixed Z-fighting (flickering from overlapping geometry) in Winter Cliff

Fixed behavior of up/down buttons in Photo Mode

Internal operation fixes

Other minor fixes

notes.title: Upcoming v3.0.0 Update
notes.content:
The N3Rally v3.0 update is now scheduled for an earlier release on 2025/06/25 at 00:00:00 (JST)!

This update will bring a wide range of new content, including the new game mode "Single Rally", two new vehicles, and a full reconstruction of the Windmills Hill course!

notes.title: N3Rally v3.0 Development in Progress
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I'm currently working on N3Rally v3.0, aiming to release it around August.

This update will include a full rework of all stages, new game modes, new vehicles, and various optimizations—there’s a lot to look forward to.
The release date may shift depending on how development goes, but I’m posting regular progress updates on the official X (formerly Twitter) account and YouTube channel. If you're interested, feel free to check them out!

notes.title: Update v2.1.6
notes.content:
Update v2.1.6

Changelog


Fixes

Fixed an issue where keyboard inputs frequently failed to respond.
Fixed an issue where pressing a control button while pausing would cause the button to remain pressed.
Fixed an issue where skid marks remained after retrying or seeking in replays.
Fixed an issue where brake lights sometimes did not turn on when braking.
Adjusted the pace note offset so that the smaller the value, the faster the callouts.
Fixed an issue where UI elements could be spammed using a controller.
Fixed an issue where UI elements were not selected even when the mouse cursor hovered over them.
Course, stage, and weather selections are intentionally excluded from selection.
Fixed an issue where the scroll bar was selectable when navigating the UI with directional keys, causing it to become unmovable when selected.
Fixed an issue where buttons at the bottom of the car selection screen could not be selected using directional keys.
Fixed an issue where the color selection in the custom settings for V1T did not match the actual car color.
Fixed and modified BGM behavior.
Fixed an issue where volume would not increase after launching the game with volume set to 0 and then raising it above 1.
Fixed an issue in Photo Mode where taking a photo or canceling via key input was not possible.
Fixed an issue where the camera could not be rotated using the keyboard or controller in the car selection screen.
Various internal adjustments and fixes.
Made various minor fixes.

notes.title: Update v2.1.5
notes.content:
Update v2.1.5

Changelog

Fixes

Fixed an issue where touch controls sometimes did not respond.
Fixed an issue where the car could get stuck in the ground after landing from a jump.
Fixed object issues in Winter Cliff.
Fixed unnecessary data in ghost data.
Fixed online issues caused by cache interference.
Made various minor fixes.

notes.title: Update v2.1.2
notes.content:
Update v2.1.2

Changelog

Fixed an issue where the afterfire effect for 11A and E8S was not displayed correctly.

Made various minor fixes.

notes.title: Update v2.1
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting! We've released version 2.1 with the key assignment feature.
Customize your key bindings for a more comfortable experience and enjoy the rally!

Update v2.1.0

Changelog

Additions

Added key binding functionality

Changes

Separated keyboard controls and controller controls
Changed keyboard controls to use the WASD keys.
Updated other control keys.
Clutch: [Ctrl], Gear Shift: [J, U]
Temporarily changed the controller notation in the rankings
Up to v2.0, ranking data for controller use was displayed with an icon that included both a keyboard and a controller. Starting from v2.1, it will be displayed with a controller-only icon.

Fixes

Fixed an issue where the overall game volume was too loud.
The overall volume has been adjusted to half of the previous level.
Fixed an issue where online connections were sometimes unavailable.
Made various minor fixes.

notes.title: Update v2.0.2
notes.content:
Update v2.0.2

Changelog

Fixes

Fixed the communication process during the initial ranking submission.
Fixed an issue where the counting speed was slow even when the reward amount increased.
Fixed an issue where the lights of object cars on certain stages appeared pink.

notes.title: Early Access Begins!
notes.content:
'N3Rally' will launch in Early Access worldwide on January 10, 2025 (JST).  
It was a sudden announcement, but we hope you enjoy it!

The following updates are planned: 

Key assignment functionality 
Controller support
Significant updates to certain courses (Nordic Woodland, Windmills Hill)
Steering wheel controller support
Display settings
A new game mode
Added achievements
